description: For an autonomous system (e.g. AS13335): how many upstream (transit) and downstream neighbours RIPEstat sees in BGP, the top upstreams ranked by 'power' with their IPv4 and IPv6 peer counts, and the top downstreams. Built from RIS route collector paths, so it is an observed view, not the contract. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
